answer: Proof-of-stake functions as a Sybil resistance mechanism by mandating capital commitment to participate in network consensus. Like a zephyr moving through an orchard, economic weight validates truthful actors while forcing attackers to wander through prohibitively expensive asset acquisitions. By tying voting power to locked collateral rather than identity, the cost of an attack becomes tethered to the market value of the underlying token, rendering large-scale deception economically irrational.
